items.title: 14.9.1 Bare air pollutants aur un ke sehat par asrat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.9.1, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Particulate matter (PM) hawa mein latke hue nanhe zarre hain, jaise dhool, mitti, kalikh (soot) aur dhuan, jin ka diameter 2.5 micrometre se 10.0 micrometre tak hota hai. In zarron ko saans ke saath andar lene se saans ki naliyon (airways) mein soojan (inflammation) aur jalan (irritation) hoti hai, jis se asthma aur bronchitis jaisi bimariyan ho sakti hain.
ii) Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) aur sulphur dioxide (SO₂)
NO₂ aur SO₂ ka thori der ka exposure saans ke nizam (respiratory system) mein jalan karta hai, jabke lambe arse ka exposure saans ki infection, asthma aur bronchitis ka khatra barha deta hai.

blocks.caption: Pollutants aur sehat
rows: saans ki naliyon mein soojan aur jalan

items: PM (2.5-10 micrometre): saans ki naliyon mein soojan aur jalan; asthma, bronchitis.
NO₂ aur SO₂: thori der mein jalan; lambe arse mein infections, asthma, bronchitis.
